posts.title: Round 8 chemo
posts.description: Heading into round 8 of chemo this week. I'm a little apprehensive as my "bounce back" didn't seem to come as quickly this time. It has been just around 4-5 days to feel "normal" again in the past, yet this time it took slightly longer to get my energy back. I did try to get some good experiences in and was lucky to do so. posts.title: nature buddies
posts.description: My parents planted blueberry bushes a while ago and they have been nice to keep. When the berries are ready, black-eyed susan's also appear. Together, I think, they just are the best Hope someone enjoys!

posts.title: Cancer Sucks. Life doesn't have to.
posts.description: There is a podcast I enjoy called Cancer Sucks. It's hosted by Jay Williams. He has been sharing his journey with Cancer. It's been refreshing to listen to. He has had many struggles, yet remains positive. One of the main "mantras" he shares is the title of this post, and it has been helpful.
